overview_description.description:
Kees Chic or Trochet (pronounced with a silent ‘t’ at the end and an extended ‘e’) is as much a social movement as it is a business. A fusion of two words, Trash + Crochet, our business idea brings to market a range of hip, trendy and ‘must-have’ lifestyle products for the globally oriented and environmentally aware city dweller. These items, such as bean bag chairs, beach bags, scuba dive bags, sturdy yoga mats, and stress balls, aiming to:

1.Reduce wastes of plastic bags.
2.Reduce women unemployment rate.
3.Innovating handmade products.

about_short_description.short_description: {Kees Chic} is an online store that sells crochet stitch products including bean bag chairs, beach bags, stress balls, and strong yoga mats.

product.name: Bean Bag Chairs
product.description: Handmade bean bag chairs crafted using crochet stitches with plastic yarn made from recycled shopping and garbage bags.

product.name: Beach Bags
product.description: Crocheted beach bags made from plastic yarn sourced from recycled shopping and garbage bags, designed for carrying personal items.

product.name: Stress Balls
product.description: Handcrafted stress balls made using crochet techniques with plastic yarn from recycled bags, designed for stress relief and tactile use.

product.name: Yoga Mats
product.description: Durable yoga mats crocheted from plastic yarn made from recycled shopping and garbage bags, intended for exercise and yoga practice.

product.name: Sadu Pouch
product.description: A handcrafted pouch made with traditional crochet stitches using plastic yarn from recycled bags, used for carrying small items.

product.name: Sadu iPad Case
product.description: A protective iPad case crocheted from plastic yarn made from recycled bags, designed to safeguard tablets.
